title: Mix and Max Box Builder — Plugin Design

n_admin.text:
Developer notes · Admin

• Frame: MixMax.AdminShell. Nav items carry href = the WP submenu URL (admin.php?page=mmbb, mmbb-campaigns, mmbb-analytics, mmbb-settings). Mount in #mmbb-admin with class mmbb-root; cancel #wpcontent left padding.
• Every page starts with MixMax.PageHeader: one primary action at most.
• KPIs: MixMax.StatCard (upIsGood=false for Discount given). Charts: LineChart, FunnelChart, BarList. Data: GET mmbb/v1/stats and /analytics, scoped by the date-range control.
• Tables use the mmbb-table classes with Badge for status; bulk bar appears on selection.
• Pop-ups (template picker, delete) are drawn from tokens: scrim, surface, radius-xl, shadow-raise. Escape and the scrim close them; focus starts on the safe action.
• First run: the checklist replaces the KPI row until a campaign has a sale.

t_wizard.text: Campaign wizard · Basics → Products → Box rules → Design → Publish

n_wizard.text:
Developer notes · Wizard

• One route per step; MixMax.Steps items carry href so finished steps stay clickable. Next is the primary button, Back is secondary, Save draft is ghost.
• The dark unsaved-changes bar appears on the first edit and holds Discard + Save campaign (max).
• Autosave a draft every 30 s: PUT mmbb/v1/campaigns/{id}.
• Products: GET mmbb/v1/products?search=&category=. Selected products keep manual order (drag handle).
• The shopper preview mounts the real storefront components with the draft config.
• Publish runs a checklist: page placed, test order, schedule. Go live is disabled until the page step is done.

t_store.text: Storefront · the Box Builder block inside the merchant's theme

n_store.text:
Developer notes · Storefront

• Desktop: 3-column ProductTile grid + sticky MixMax.BoxPanel. Phone: 2-up grid + MixMax.BoxSummaryBar sticky at bottom 12px.
• Tiers and prices are recomputed on the server (woocommerce_before_calculate_totals); the client only displays.
• POST mmbb/v1/cart/box validates rules + stock, then adds one bundled line (or box + items, per Settings).
• Unlocking a tier shows MixMax.Toast once per tier.
• Countdown only with the campaign's real end date. Only N left uses real stock at or below the threshold.
• Northwind Pantry is a made-up shop standing in for any theme.

n_wp.text:
Developer notes · WordPress

• Block mmbb/box-builder (block.json, dynamic PHP render). Attributes: campaignId, layout (panel | bar | both), columns. The editor shows a live preview of the builder; the sidebar panel picks the campaign.
• Shortcode [mmbb_box id="12"] renders the same output.
• Order email: box contents and gift message added via woocommerce_order_item_meta / email hooks; plain table markup, 600–680 px, inline styles only.
